title: Token exchange with a third-party actor token: refused
lede: {{castApp}} exchanges a PingOne user token plus a {{vendorName}} token. The check '{{failedLabel}}' fails, so PingOne refuses and issues nothing. Mock only. The refusal text is what PingOne returned when we measured it live (2026-10-27); the order PingOne evaluates checks in is UNVERIFIED.

steps.title: Subject token from PingOne
steps.what: {{castApp}} gets a PingOne access token with client_credentials: the subject token. A signed-in user's token works the same way; the live run used client credentials (UNVERIFIED: which claims a client-credentials token carries).

steps.title: Ask the issuer for a token
steps.what: {{castApp}} also gets a token from {{vendorName}}. This is the actor token. It is signed by that issuer, not by PingOne.

steps.title: Third-party JWT comes back
steps.what: The actor token, shown decoded. State: {{stateLabel}}.

steps.title: Token exchange request
steps.what: {{castApp}} sends the RFC 8693 exchange with actor_token_type urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:jwt. The request shape was MEASURED live against PingOne on 2026-10-27 (the guide shows it only as an image).

steps.title: PingOne uses the issuer keys
steps.what: PingOne verifies the actor token's signature against the key set of the trusted issuer: the inline JWKS configured in the trusted-issuer call (or fetched from the JWKS URL when configured that way). The order of checks here is ours (UNVERIFIED).
steps.why:
GET <JWKS URL of the trusted issuer>
keys for {{vendorIssuer}}

steps.title: Keys of the trusted issuer
steps.what: The key set the trusted issuer was created with. The signature check is REAL here: a valid token verifies and a bad-signature token fails against this JWKS. PingOne now runs its checks: assignment, issuer, signature, exp, iat, nbf, audience.

steps.title: Refused: {{failedLabel}}
steps.what: The check '{{failedLabel}}' failed ({{failedDetail}}). No token is issued. The error text is PingOne's own, MEASURED live (HTTP 400, invalid_request); the order of checks when several fail is UNVERIFIED.
